verdict.rationale: Whether a SaaS product's source is available under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only GitHub-hosted client SDKs and OpenAPI specification files, which are developer building blocks rather than the product's own source, and no open license is mentioned anywhere. No evidence shows the Docusign product source is readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
